newsitem.title: USA: Unisys says ISS proxy advice ignores its progress.
newsitem.headline: Unisys says ISS proxy advice ignores its progress.

text.p: Unisys Corp said Monday that Instituional Shareholder Services has ignored the financial progress the company has made last year when it advised shareholders earlier today to withhold their votes from the four Unisys directors seeking reelection.

ISS, which advises on proxy issues, also said that it back ed a shareholder proposal to repeal the company's classified board structure and for the annual election of all directors, and that shareholders should reject a proposal from Greenway Partners LP, the company's largest shareholder, to sell or spinoff its computer hardware business.
That plan was rejected at the company's annual meeting last year as well, said Unisys.

The company added that it beleives that the ISS recommendation overlooks the progress and momentum the company achieved in 1996, when it improved its results each quarter, while achieveing its highest operating profit margin in three years during the last quarter of 1996.
Unisys said it plans to be profitable in 1997, and that change now would send the wrong message.
